en: Ne goes before the verb and pas after it. Parle starts with a consonant, so it stays ne.
Ne becomes n’ before a vowel: il n’est pas content.
Which is the negative of J’aime les épinards?
Je ne aime pas les épinards.
Ne becomes n’ before aime, and pas comes straight after the verb.
Which is the negative of Nous jouons au tennis?
Nous ne jouons pas au tennis.
Nous jouons ne pas au tennis.
Nous ne pas jouons au tennis.
Ne … pas goes around the verb: ne jouons pas.
What does Je ne regarde jamais la télé mean?
I don’t watch TV any more
What does Elle ne joue plus du piano mean?
She doesn’t play the piano any more
She plays the piano a lot
Ne … plus means not any more, so she used to play but stopped.
What does Tu ne travailles pas mean?
Ne … pas makes the verb negative: you don’t work.
Ne … jamais means never. Ne … plus means not any more.
Which pair means not any more?
Ne … plus means not any more or no longer.
How do you say I never drink milk in French?
Je ne bois jamais de lait.
Je ne bois plus de lait.
Never is ne … jamais. Ne … plus would mean not any more.
How do you say We don’t live in Paris any more in French?
Not any more is ne … plus, and ne becomes n’ before habitons.
How do you say She doesn’t like horses in French?
Doesn’t like is n’aime pas. N’aime plus would mean she doesn’t like them any more.
Which is the negative of J’ai un chat?
Je ne ai pas de chat.
Ne becomes n’ before ai, and un becomes de after a negative.
After a negative, du, de la and des change to de: pas de lait.
After a negative, des changes to de. D’ is only used before a vowel.
Ne goes before the verb and jamais goes after it.
On ne va plus à la piscine.
On ne plus va à la piscine.
On va ne plus à la piscine.
Ne goes before the verb and plus goes after it.
In the passé composé, ne … pas goes around avoir: je n’ai pas fini.
Tu aimes le foot ? Which answer is correct?
Non, je n’aime pas le foot.
Non, je aime pas le foot.
You need both parts, n’ and pas, around the verb.
Tu as faim ? – Non, je n’ai ___ faim.
The negative needs pas after the verb: je n’ai pas faim.
Mon grand-père a 90 ans. Il ne travaille ___.
He has stopped working, so ne … plus (not any more) fits.
Ne needs a partner such as jamais. Souvent and toujours cannot go with ne here.
What does Il n’y a plus de biscuits mean?
Il n’y a plus de means there is no more of something, so the biscuits are all gone.
What does Je n’ai plus faim mean?
I am not hungry any more
Ne … plus means not any more.
What does Nous ne sortons jamais le soir mean?
We never go out in the evening
We always go out in the evening
We are going out this evening
In a negative sentence, which word comes after the verb?
Ne comes before the verb and pas comes after it.
Which is the negative of Il pleut?
Ne … pas goes around the verb pleut.
Which is the negative of Vous êtes en retard?
Vous ne êtes pas en retard.
Ne becomes n’ before êtes, and pas comes straight after the verb.
How do you say They never go to school on Sundays in French?
Ils ne vont jamais à l’école le dimanche.
Ils vont toujours à l’école le dimanche.
Ils ne vont pas jamais à l’école le dimanche.
Never is ne … jamais. You do not add pas as well.
Je ne me lève pas tôt.
Je me ne lève pas tôt.
Je ne lève me pas tôt.
With a reflexive verb, ne goes before me: je ne me lève pas.

en.title: Saying no
en.teach: Put ne … pas around the verb to say not: Je ne mange pas. Ne … jamais means never and ne … plus means not any more. Ne becomes n’ before a vowel: Je n’aime pas.
